selection: Hash order of all release record names before viewing annotations; first16 development,next8 reserved evaluation; remaining untouched
downloadPolicy: Only development headers and manually reviewed atr annotations initially; no evaluation annotations or waveforms
aggregation: Record-level summaries; windows are repeated observations, not independent patients
limitations: Record separation does not prove subject independence without a subject mapping.
Reference annotations are manually reviewed, not an assertion of perfect beat or rhythm labels.
RR includes all accepted beat types; ectopic NN-only analyses must be separately reported.

evaluationBeforeUnsealing.primary: Strictly reduce unweighted record-level absolute CV mismatch versus old clipped sampler
evaluationBeforeUnsealing.secondary: Normalized 5th/95th RR quantile absolute errors; report separately and flag any per-record worsening >0.02
evaluationBeforeUnsealing.temporal: Report lag-one mismatch separately; neither sampler claims AV-node memory
evaluationBeforeUnsealing.simulation: 100 deterministic seeds per record at the record median reference rate;60-second windows; Monte Carlo replicates are not patients
evaluationBeforeUnsealing.noRetuning: Do not tune this candidate to the reserved results or change acceptance after seeing them

windowConfoundersBeforeEvaluation.primary: Full AF windows without paced(/,f), unknown(Q) or noise(|,~) annotations. Exclude the whole window, never bridge removed beats.
windowConfoundersBeforeEvaluation.secondary: Also report all-AF-window RR summaries and counts of excluded windows. A/V ectopy remains in primary RR and is counted; RR is not NN.
windowConfoundersBeforeEvaluation.note: Criteria fixed before any reserved annotation download; gamma candidate CV remains0.22, not refitted.
